title: Rademacher Complexity Bounds for Parameterized Quantum Circuits Generated by Pauli Strings
summary: In this study, we analyze the Rademacher complexity $ \mathcal{R}_{M} $ of a parameterized unitary whose generators are chosen from $ n $-qubit Pauli strings. Although generalization bounds for quantum machine learning models have been studied in several settings, explicit Rademacher-complexity bounds for parameterized unitaries generated by Pauli strings remain less transparent.
